label: TP
reason: Assessed Alert 1 (java/xss). The sink expression at L95-L101 writes to response.getWriter() using encodeForHTML(new String(input)). Tracing the data flow reveals 'input' derives from 'bar', which derives from 'param'. 'param' is populated from request.getHeaders('BenchmarkTest01164'), which is user-controllable. Although encodeForHTML is present in the flow, the instruction mandates preferring alert-TP when attacker-controlled data reaches the sink expression, even if mitigation functions appear in the codeFlow.

evidence.note: User input sourced from request.getHeaders("BenchmarkTest01164") assigned to param.
param processed through Base64 round-trip in doSomething, assigned to bar, then converted to input byte array.
Sink expression write to response.getWriter() using input derived from user header, triggering java/xss alert.
